title_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Sanad and Signification - Episode 4
description_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Sanad and Signification - Episode 4, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode from the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program discussing the chain of transmission (sanad) and indications (dalala) of Hadith al-Thaqalayn.
